title: basic-auth gateway secrets: creating a secret requires the workspace create grant via validate_can_create_gateway_secret, not the after-request MANAGE grant
answers: Why could a user without workspace permission still create a gateway secret when they were denied creating experiments?
Which validator decides who may create gateway secrets in a workspace when workspaces are enabled?
How should a new create route in the basic-auth app be gated on workspace create permission?
body:
Path: Basic-auth authorization for the gateway secret create request (POST /api/3.0/mlflow/gateway/secrets/create, which stores a provider credential), resolved through the route-to-validator map in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py, keyed by CreateGatewaySecret.
Rule: Creating a gateway secret is a workspace-scoped create. CreateGatewaySecret maps to mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:validate_can_create_gateway_secret, which returns _user_can_create_in_workspace(), the same check used by the experiment and registered-model create validators. The after-request set_can_manage_gateway_secret_permission grant only records the creator as MANAGE owner of the new secret; it does not authorize the create. Per the PR description, with workspaces disabled this check allows any authenticated user.
Symptom: With MLFLOW_ENABLE_WORKSPACES on, a user with no workspace create grant could still create gateway secrets, although the same account was denied CreateExperiment and CreateRegisteredModel (GHSA-4449-4cjp-ffp5).
Constraints: Applies to the basic-auth app only. Covers only the secret create route. Model-definition and endpoint creation still gate on USE of the referenced resources and were deliberately left unchanged in this PR, so they do not follow this rule yet.
applies: Route authorization for gateway secret creation in the basic-auth app when workspaces are enabled; also the pattern for any new create route that persists a resource.
says: Users without workspace creation rights are still able to add new gateway secrets.
Block accounts from adding provider credentials in workspaces where resource creation is disallowed.
Users denied experiment creation in a workspace can surprisingly still create gateway secrets.
Restrict saving API keys and gateway secrets to members with workspace create permissions.
search: When MLFLOW_ENABLE_WORKSPACES is enabled in basic-auth, creating a gateway secret via POST /api/3.0/mlflow/gateway/secrets/create (CreateGatewaySecret) requires workspace create permission through validate_can_create_gateway_secret, which calls _user_can_create_in_workspace(). The after-request grant set_can_manage_gateway_secret_permission only records the creator as MANAGE owner and does not authorize secret creation. When workspaces are disabled, any authenticated user is allowed to create gateway secrets. This check applies to the secret create route in the basic-auth app, while model-definition and endpoint creation remain gated on USE of referenced resources.
